in_marathi.name: Supriyo
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wealthy, Precious, Valuable
in_marathi.long_meaning: Supriyo हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Supriyo is a Sanskrit and Bengali name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'suprī', meaning 'precious, dear, valuable, costly, rich'. It is a name that signifies prosperity and wealth, and is often given to boys as a symbol of hope and aspiration for a prosperous and successful future.
